implementationNotes: quest_graph.py (deps and milestones views; status as word, border and colour; %% edges: quest-dependencies; exits 3 over the node cap) with 3 tests including a truth round-trip against its own source. Example: this suite's build plan generated from Quest, truth-checked live in CI. Evals 7 and 8: with skill 7/7 and 7/7, without 5/7 and 5/7 (iteration-1; baseline drew completed tasks for 'what's left' and tasks outside the epic, and missed accessibility fields; both arms drew the recorded edges correctly). Note: an earlier edit passing --check-ac 5 (the task has 4 criteria) was rejected whole and the task was completed before the record was filled; this edit repairs it.
